Bornholm is a Danish municipality included in the national clinical quality reporting for atrial fibrillation treatment. As part of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) annual reports published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), Bornholm is one of 98 municipalities analyzed to benchmark and drive local healthcare quality. Specifically, local data concerning stroke (apopleksi) events among atrial fibrillation patients is utilized in the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic strokes via anticoagulant treatment [^src1]. 

In the 2022–2023 AFDK report, Bornholm's specific statistical outputs for Indicator 5 are documented, detailing patient cohort sizes and confidence intervals [^src1]. By the 2024 reporting cycle, Bornholm's administrative and clinical data is structurally categorized under a [[sundhedsklynge|Sundhedsklynge]] (health cluster), integrating the municipality into broader regional healthcare groupings [^src2].
